```yaml
name: Claude Code

on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  claude:
    if: contains(github.event.comment.body, '@claude') && github.event.comment.author_association == 'MEMBER'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Claude Code
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          if [[ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" == "issue_comment" ]]; then
            target_type="issue"
            target_number=$(jq -r '.issue.number' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
          elif [[ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" == "pull_request_review_comment" ]]; then
            target_type="pr"
            target_number=$(jq -r '.pull_request.number' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
          else
            echo "Unsupported event: $GITHUB_EVENT_NAME"
            exit 1
          fi

          comment_body=$(jq -r '.comment.body' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")

          payload=$(jq -n --arg body "$comment_body" '{"model":"claude-3-haiku-20240307","max_tokens":1024,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":$body}]}')

          response=$(curl -s -X POST https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -H "x-api-key: $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" \
            -d "$payload" | jq -r '.content[0].text')

          if [[ "$target_type" == "issue" ]]; then
            gh issue comment "$target_number" -b "$response"
          else
            gh pr comment "$target_number" -b "$response"
          fi
```
